label: getTimingOffsetPPM multiplies by ppmScale instead of dividing
the designing constructor does not set the timing offset
the designing constructor's redundant Resampler::reset() is dropped
why: The base constructor's own body ends in `reset()`, and everything the designing constructor does after that -- design the LowPassFIR, allocate the bank, transpose it into it -- touches only `coeffs` and `coeffsBorrowed`, neither of which `reset` reads or writes.  So the second call cannot change a byte of the object.  The call is written because the OBJECT contains it (`call _ZN9Resampler5resetEv` at .text+0x35671); this entry records that the redundancy is the original's, not that the test is weak.
